# ship-analytics

Your interface to the `analytics` ops. Invoke each over ConnectRPC:

```
ship ops call <name> --json '<args-json>'
```

Reads are safe (C0). Commands carry a blast-radius class. Open an op's reference
page for full args, return shape, capability, and an example.

## Reads

- [`analytics.get_session`](references/docs/analytics.get_session.mdoc) — Analytics detail for one session.
- [`analytics.list_sessions`](references/docs/analytics.list_sessions.mdoc) — List agent sessions with rollup metrics (tokens, cost, tool use).
- [`analytics.session_turns`](references/docs/analytics.session_turns.mdoc) — Per-turn cost/token/timing breakdown for a session.
- [`analytics.tool_usage`](references/docs/analytics.tool_usage.mdoc) — Tool-usage rollup across sessions.
